prompts.image: Use case: sketch-to-render / photorealistic-natural. Create ONE final live-action film still, 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. Input 1 is a WORKING BLENDER RENDER, strictly a camera, spatial layout, scale and composition reference, NOT the final visual style. Input 2 is a SMALL PERSPECTIVE/BLOCKING GUIDE of the same camera: its converging lines explain real spatial directions and its primitive figures mark human placement. Do not reproduce the guide, linework, captions, faceted bodies, plastic surfaces or crude geometry. Rebuild the visible scene as a convincing photographed physical place while retaining the prescribed viewpoint, major dimensions, openings, object positions and framing. Improve natural material variation, construction details, contact shadows and realistic light; do not redesign the layout or invent different architecture. No game-engine look, no illustration, no split panels, no watermark. Early-1990s provincial Polish atmosphere, understated cinematic realism and restrained film grain, no modern products. Input 3 is the exact production identity and wardrobe reference: Dariusz is the chubby red-brown wavy-haired boy with rectangular dark glasses on the LEFT of that reference; Owczar is the slim dark-blond boy in the burgundy track jacket on its RIGHT. Both are 13–14, clean-shaven. Preserve their specific faces, hair, age, body shape and clothing. Owczar has TWO cream stripes on each sleeve, ivory T-shirt, loose blue jeans and worn pale canvas trainers. Dariusz has an open grey-blue plaid overshirt, grey/navy striped T-shirt, dark loose jeans and dark worn trainers. Their positions in the final shot are dictated by the shot instructions, not by the identity reference layout. Replace all visible primitive stand-ins with anatomically natural boys, and insert the boys where requested even if the clean render is empty. No adult beard, no extra people. SHOT ACTION AND COMPOSITION: Both boys seen from behind, Owczar on screen left using the left joystick and buttons; Dariusz on screen right watching, not playing. Keep the screen visible between their heads. Dim, close, slightly hazy basement arcade, motivated warm practical lights mixed with soft CRT illumination. Retain real cabinet artwork and its physical shapes. Exposure must keep faces readable where present; believable darkness, not uniformly bright room.
prompts.animation: 0.0–3.0s: Owczar, already on screen left, makes tiny left-hand joystick adjustments and two small right-finger button taps, keeping both hands below the screen. Dariusz, already on screen right, watches with only subtle breathing. Both keep their heads and shoulders in their original positions outside the CRT opening; the entire display and all four corners remain unobstructed throughout. Camera: rigid locked-off tripod, no push-in, pan, zoom or focus breathing. Use @Image1 only for the existing boys facial identities, hair and ages; retain clothing, positions and rear viewpoint from the Start Frame. Cabinet, CRT glass, bezel, controls, marquee lettering and room geometry stay fixed at identical image coordinates. Preserve the frozen game picture for later replacement. Only faint reflected CRT light variation. No leaning inward, raised arms, screen occlusion, new people, cuts, distortion or morphing.
